about: Findings the no-network test accepts. Each entry names the file (a glob relative to a build folder), the rule and the exact finding, how many times it must appear (exactly), the build targets it applies to (all when absent), and why. CONTRACT section 6 allows one network read outside the cloud: the PDF chunk re-reads the PDF address. The cloud code is cloud.js alone, built from src/cloud, and its addresses are pinned to the hosts in PRIVACY.md. Any other address or network call fails the build.

entries.reason: CONTRACT 6: on a PDF address the PDF chunk reads that same address once more, from the cache, to hand the bytes to the bundled viewer. The scan checks the argument is location.href.
PDF.js imports its worker script on the main thread when it cannot start a worker. workerSrc is set to the bundled /pdf/worker.js, and the page CSP allows only 'self'.
The PDF.js worker imports its JavaScript fallback for the image decoder from wasmUrl, which is set to the bundled /pdf/wasm/ folder. The page CSP allows only 'self'.

The service worker reads the bundled /cloud.js at start (a check that importScripts exists, then the call). Service workers may not use import() or a late importScripts. The file only defines functions.
The one request function of the cloud code (src/cloud/http.ts). It refuses any address outside the connected provider's list before sending, and connect-src allows only the cloud hosts.

Gives the Google sign-in back on Disconnect.
Google Drive's file address: list, read, make folders, remove.
Google Drive's upload address: write files.
The name of the one Google scope asked for. It is a name, never requested.
